# AQ host catalog 2.7.0

The delivery lineage of catalog 2.6.0, so that a judgment sees the evidence an
agent reported: the result report's conclusion now holds up to 4096 bytes, and
`work.read` passes all of it on.

## Changed

- `work.read` 2.7.0: the `conclusion` fact is a string of at most 4096 bytes
  (the result report's bound), `""` when the task has no result yet. In 2.6.0
  it was at most 512. Every other fact is unchanged.

  It still fits a `judgment.assess` context item (`text`, at most 8192 bytes).
  A 2.7.0 answer with a conclusion over 512 bytes does not fit 2.6.0, so an
  artifact sealed on 2.6.0 keeps its 2.6.0 `work.read`; the capability stays
  `work.read`.

Every other contract of 2.6.0, and every event, is byte-identical.

## Files

`registry.json`, `manifest.json`, `fixtures.json` and `notes.json` are
generated by `crates/aq-playbooks-cli/tests/catalog_v2_7_contract.rs` and
pinned by `generated_catalog_files_are_pinned`. Regenerate from the workspace
root with `cargo test -p aq-playbooks-cli --test catalog_v2_7_contract
write_catalog_v2_7 -- --ignored`.
